title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan and Lakshmi arrive home before Malar, forcing Mathi to lie that she went to the temple. After a tense escape, Malar sincerely thanks Mathi and Shruthi for saving her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Palanivel discovers the pregnancy test kit despite Kathir's attempt to hide it. Without confirming the truth, he announces at Pandian's house that Kathir is becoming a father.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran is weighed down by Chozhan's criticism. Meanwhile, the client releases the payment after Cheran's intervention, relieving Nila and her friends.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Unaware of Sinthamani's scheme, Rekha accepts her request to stay with her father until his recovery. Meanwhile, Muthu and Meena begin constructing their room with a Pooja.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi slaps the driver for his misconduct during driving practice. Sethupathi and Rajangam step in on time to rescue her family from the trouble caused by his men.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Kasthuri's Life Takes a New Turn
description: Soniya steps in to resolve the intense clash between Arjun and Madhu. Fulfilling his father's wish, Jaganathan decides to move forward with Kasthuri's marriage to Maran.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy rejects Lakshmi's suggestion of Indhira as Murugan's bride. Ganesan confirms Murugan's love for Indhira and asks him to find out whether Indhira feels the same.
